steps.name: profile-rows
steps.check: (function(){var r=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.list button.li[data-act="go"][data-id="doc"]'));var b=r.map(function(x){var e=x.querySelector('.badge');return e?e.textContent:''});var n=document.querySelector('.note.danger');var ok=r.length===4&&b.join('|')==='Còn hiệu lực|Còn 30 ngày|Còn hiệu lực|Đã hết hạn'&&!document.querySelector('.scr [data-act="docUp"]')&&n&&/hết hạn 14 ngày/.test(n.textContent)&&r.every(function(x){return x.querySelector('.chev')&&x.getBoundingClientRect().height>=44});return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+r.length+' dòng · '+b.join(', ')})()

steps.name: open-expired
steps.check: (function(){var t=(document.querySelector('.big-title h1')||{}).textContent;var v=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.list .li .val')).map(function(x){return x.textContent}).join('|');var f=document.querySelector('.foot [data-act="docUp"]');var orange=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.view .abtn')).filter(function(x){return !/sec2|ghost|dz/.test(x.className)&&x.offsetParent});var ok=PROV.top().n==='doc'&&t==='Chứng chỉ an toàn môi chất lạnh'&&/Đã hết hạn/.test(document.querySelector('.big-title .badge').textContent)&&document.querySelector('.photo')&&v==='10/09/2026|Điện lạnh|10/03/2026|12/03/2026'&&document.querySelector('.note.danger')&&f&&!f.classList.contains('sec2')&&f.getAttribute('aria-disabled')!=='true'&&orange.length===1;return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+t+' · '+v+' · nút cam '+orange.length})()

steps.name: upload-busy
steps.check: (document.querySelector('.foot [aria-busy="true"]')&&PROV.S.uploading===3?'PASS đang tải lên':'FAIL không thấy trạng thái đang tải lên')

steps.name: upload-done
steps.check: (function(){var f=document.querySelector('.foot [data-act="docUp"]');var v=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.list .li .val')).map(function(x){return x.textContent}).join('|');var t=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.a-toast')).pop();var ok=/Chờ duyệt/.test(document.querySelector('.big-title .badge').textContent)&&f&&f.classList.contains('sec2')&&f.getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true'&&+getComputedStyle(f).opacity<0.5&&document.querySelector('.foot .note-line')&&/24\/09\/2026/.test(v)&&/Đang chờ duyệt/.test(v)&&t&&/chờ nền tảng duyệt/.test(t.textContent);return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+v})()

steps.name: tap-disabled-upload
steps.check: (PROV.S.uploading==null&&PROV.S.docs[3][2]==='review'&&!document.querySelector('.foot [aria-busy]')?'PASS bấm nút khoá không tải lại':'FAIL vẫn tải lại khi đang chờ duyệt')

steps.name: back-to-profile
steps.check: (function(){var r=document.querySelectorAll('.list button.li[data-id="doc"]')[3];var ok=PROV.top().n==='profile'&&r&&/Chờ duyệt/.test(r.querySelector('.badge').textContent)&&!document.querySelector('.note.danger');return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+PROV.top().n})()

steps.name: open-valid
steps.check: (function(){var f=document.querySelector('.foot [data-act="docUp"]');var n=document.querySelector('.note.neutral');var ok=f&&f.classList.contains('sec2')&&f.getAttribute('aria-disabled')!=='true'&&n&&/30 ngày/.test(n.textContent);return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+(n?n.textContent:'')})()

steps.name: open-soon
steps.check: (function(){var f=document.querySelector('.foot [data-act="docUp"]');var n=document.querySelector('.note.warn');var ok=/Còn 30 ngày/.test(document.querySelector('.big-title .badge').textContent)&&n&&/24\/10\/2026/.test(n.textContent)&&f&&!f.classList.contains('sec2');return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+(n?n.textContent:'')})()

steps.name: missing-doc
steps.check: (function(){var e=document.querySelector('.scr .empty b');var ok=e&&/Không tìm thấy giấy tờ/.test(e.textContent)&&document.querySelector('.scr .empty [data-act="back"]')&&!document.querySelector('.foot');return (ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+(e?e.textContent:'')})()

steps.name: notif-deeplink

steps.name: notif-back

steps.name: tech-notifs-plain

steps.name: english

steps.name: offline
steps.check: (function(){var e=document.querySelector('.scr .empty b');return (e&&/Không có kết nối/.test(e.textContent)&&!document.querySelector('.foot')?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+(e?e.textContent:'')})()

steps.name: slow-skeleton

steps.name: slow-loaded

steps.name: esc-back-doc

steps.name: dz-decline-faded
steps.check: (function(){var b=document.querySelector('.sheet .abtn.dz');return ((function(b){return b&&b.getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true'&&+getComputedStyle(b).opacity<0.5})(b)?'PASS ':'FAIL ')+(b?b.textContent:'không có nút')})()
